decisions.statement: A process in a container is left out of everything the tick weighs.
A tick that cannot read the memory the host has free disarms its headroom leg.
A tick that cannot read the process table does nothing rather than guessing.
Trees are signalled before single processes.
A tree is signalled from its leaves up to its root.
A tick that overruns its deadline is abandoned rather than left to run on.
A kill that throws is said aloud and the rest of the plan still runs.
A tick first takes away every group a run left under the topmost group the reaper may write in.
A sweep that throws is said aloud and the tick still weighs the host.

definition: one pass of reading the host, planning the kills and signalling them
